source.description: A compact citation card for a book, article, or other source: type badge, title, author/year, status, and an optional progress bar.

quote.description: A cited passage: the quoted markdown, a right-aligned citation line, and an optional commentary line.

term.description: An inline term with an optional tooltip and keyboard-focusable definition.

at.description: A monospace timestamp chip, optionally linked to a source with the time appended to the URL.

mark.description: A highlighter-style inline marker, tinted by kind: insight, question, disagree, or todo.
